jyutping: haang4 dak1 jiu4 jiu4 fong2 fong2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for walking or moving unsteadily and nearly falling.

examples.english: They were drunk and began to totter along, nearly falling into the road.
examples.traditional: 佢飲醉咗，行得搖搖晃晃，差啲跌落馬路。
